claims.title: Certify an empirical quaternion objective and compare the actual guarded operation

quoted_fields.interface: The acquired bank compresses into35 homogeneous-quartic coefficients on a unit quaternion. The generic four-variable resultant template is not a completed generic solver implementation; finite SOS successes do not prove a fast worst-case oracle. Candidate-dependent runtime needs source-clock padding/isolation. The60,000-call retained-bank comparison is counterfactual from one actual final bath, not repeated sequential reset operations. Ordinary SLSQP gives identical rational candidates/yield and Nelder-Mead is comparable. No unique solver advantage, hardware or total-cost superiority.

quoted_fields.interface: The completed review accepts a one-complete-source-call CP instrument under trusted isolated coherent controls and the SAME source map across branches. Output is neither H rho H, an inverse, a prepared kernel state nor a recovery algorithm. Direct scalar objective use gives a smaller Bernoulli signal than the ordinary positive Bell-sign probe and needs more coherent controls. The222-CNOT/398-single-gate budget is a compositional upper bound, not a full executed elementary netlist or hardware result. N1041 supplies only its actual isolated-control scope.
